A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''individual''' served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the Alliance and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The sergeant owned a [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] that he named "[[Zarra (rifle)|Zarra]]," but he did not tell anyone why he gave his rifle that name. He had light skin and was rather heavyset with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and a mustache that were graying. The sergeant sometimes carried an ammunition [[Belt/Legends|belt]] and wore a brown&ndash;colored uniform with [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] and a belt which had at least two pouches.<ref name="SWGTCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel sergeant first appeared in [[2008]] as part of [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|''Champions of the Force'']], the first set of cards for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'', a virtual card game created by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment to go along with<ref name="SWGTCG" /> the company's [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> The card game was shut down at the same time as ''Star Wars Galaxies'',<ref name="SWGTCG" /> which was closed on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> He was featured on the Rebel Sergeant card, which was illustrated by the artist [[Svetlin Velinov]].<ref name="Game Interface">[[Sony]] Online Entertainment interface for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''</ref>
